args.name: NAME
args.description: Name of the new virtual device; may also be given after the "name" keyword

options.name: link
options.description: Physical device the new virtual device operates on

options.name: parentdev
options.description: Name of the parent device to create the new device under

options.name: name

name: txqueuelen
txqlen
options.description: Transmit queue length of the new device

options.name: address
options.description: Link layer (station) address of the new device

name: broadcast
brd

options.name: mtu
options.description: MTU of the new device

options.name: index

options.name: numtxqueues

options.name: numrxqueues
options.description: Number of receive queues for the new device

options.name: gso_max_size

options.name: gso_ipv4_max_size

options.description: Bring the device up

options.name: down

options.name: arp
options.description: Change the NOARP flag on the device

options.name: multicast
options.description: Change the MULTICAST flag on the device

options.description: Change the ALLMULTI flag on the device, making the driver pass all multicast packets to the kernel

options.name: promisc
options.description: Change the PROMISC flag on the device, activating promiscuous operation

options.name: trailers
options.description: Change the NOTRAILERS flag on the device; unused by Linux, kept for BSD compatibility

options.name: carrier
options.description: Set the carrier state reported for the device

options.name: protodown
options.description: Change the PROTODOWN state on the device, indicating a protocol error was detected on the port

options.name: protodown_reason
options.description: Turn a protodown reason on or off; reason bit names are listed under /etc/iproute2/protodown_reasons.d/

name: txqueuelen
txqlen

options.name: name

options.description: Peer netnsid for a cross-netns interface

options.name: alias
options.description: Give the device a symbolic name for easy reference

options.name: master
options.description: Set the master device of the device (enslave it)

options.name: nomaster
options.description: Unset the master device of the device (release it)

options.name: vrf
options.description: Enslave the device to this VRF device

options.name: addrgenmode
options.description: Set the IPv6 address generation mode

options.name: vf
options.description: Virtual function to configure; the associated physical function must be given with 'dev'

options.name: mac
options.description: Change the station address of the virtual function selected by "vf"

options.name: vlan
options.description: Assign a VLAN to the virtual function selected by "vf"; 0 disables VLAN tagging and filtering

options.name: qos
options.description: Priority bits included in the VLAN tag of the virtual function selected by "vf"

options.name: proto
options.description: VLAN protocol used for the VLAN tag of the virtual function selected by "vf"

options.name: rate
options.description: Allowed transmit bandwidth in Mbps for the virtual function selected by "vf"; superseded by max_tx_rate

options.name: max_tx_rate
options.description: Maximum transmit bandwidth in Mbps for the virtual function selected by "vf"; 0 disables rate limiting

options.name: min_tx_rate
options.description: Minimum transmit bandwidth in Mbps for the virtual function selected by "vf"; 0 disables rate limiting

options.name: spoofchk
options.description: Turn packet spoof checking on or off for the virtual function selected by "vf"

options.name: query_rss
options.description: Allow querying the RSS configuration of the virtual function selected by "vf"

options.name: state
options.description: Virtual link state as seen by the virtual function selected by "vf"

options.name: trust
options.description: Trust the user of the virtual function selected by "vf", allowing them to set features that may impact security or performance

options.name: node_guid
options.description: Node GUID of the Infiniband virtual function selected by "vf"

options.name: port_guid
options.description: Port GUID of the Infiniband virtual function selected by "vf"

options.name: xdp
options.description: Attach or detach an XDP ("eXpress Data Path") BPF program run on every packet at driver level, falling back to the generic variant if the driver has no native support

options.name: xdpgeneric
options.description: Like xdp, but always use the driver-independent generic XDP variant

options.name: xdpdrv
options.description: Like xdp, but require native driver XDP support and disable hardware offloads

options.name: xdpoffload
options.description: Like xdp, but install the program in the hardware/firmware of the adapter

options.name: object
options.description: BPF ELF file holding the XDP program to attach

options.name: pinned
options.description: Already pinned BPF program in the BPF file system to attach as the XDP program

options.name: section
options.description: Section of the XDP object file that contains the BPF program code (default: "prog")

options.name: program
options.description: Name of the BPF program to attach from the XDP object file; overrides section and requires an iproute2 built with libbpf

options.name: verbose
options.description: Print the XDP verifier log even when the program loads successfully

options.name: inet
options.description: Set an IPv4 devconf parameter, mapping directly to the kernel's IPv4 interface sysctls

args.name: VALUE
args.description: Value for the parameter: "on" or "off" for the boolean parameters, otherwise a number (rp_filter 0-2, arp_announce 0-2, arp_ignore 0-8, arp_accept 0-2, force_igmp_version 0-3, IGMP intervals in milliseconds)

subcommands.name: add
subcommands.description: Create a new IPv4 tunnel device (ipip, gre, sit, isatap, or vti)

args.description: Tunnel device name; defaults to a name derived from the mode (e.g. tunl0, gre0, sit0, ip_vti0)

options.name: mode
options.description: Tunnel encapsulation mode

options.name: remote
options.description: Remote endpoint address of the tunnel ('any' for a non-point-to-point tunnel)

options.name: local
options.description: Fixed local address for tunneled packets; must be an address on another local interface

options.name: key
options.description: GRE key to use for both input and output (only GRE tunnels)

options.name: ikey
options.description: GRE key to use for input only (only GRE tunnels)

options.name: okey
options.description: GRE key to use for output only (only GRE tunnels)

options.name: seq

options.name: iseq
options.description: Require that all input packets are serialized (only GRE tunnels)

options.name: oseq
options.description: Enable sequencing of outgoing packets (only GRE tunnels)

options.name: csum
options.description: Generate and require checksums for tunneled packets in both directions (only GRE tunnels)

options.name: icsum
options.description: Require that all input packets have a correct checksum (only GRE tunnels)

options.name: ocsum
options.description: Generate checksums for outgoing packets (only GRE tunnels)

options.name: ttl
options.description: Fixed TTL on tunneled packets; 'inherit' copies the TTL from the original IP header

dsfield

options.name: dev

subcommands.name: policy
subcommands.description: Manage IPsec/xfrm security policy database (SPD) entries

name: add
update
subcommands.description: Add a new security policy, or update an existing one

options.name: src
options.description: Source address (and optional prefix length) to select traffic for this policy

options.name: dst
options.description: Destination address (and optional prefix length) to select traffic for this policy

options.name: dev
options.description: Restrict the policy's selector to traffic on this device

options.name: proto
options.description: Restrict the selector to an upper-layer protocol, optionally with ports/type/code

options.name: dir
options.description: Traffic direction this policy applies to

options.name: ctx
options.description: SELinux security context for this policy

options.name: mark
options.description: Mark that must match for this policy to apply

options.name: mask
options.description: Mask applied to the preceding mark value

options.name: index
options.description: Explicit policy index (must be a multiple of 8 plus the direction)

options.name: ptype
options.description: Policy type

options.name: action
options.description: Action to take for traffic matching this policy

options.name: priority
options.description: Priority of this policy; lower numbers are matched first

options.name: flag
options.description: Optional policy flag (repeatable)

options.name: if_id
options.description: Interface ID binding this policy to an xfrm interface

options.name: offload
options.description: Offload this policy to hardware in packet mode, e.g. 'offload packet dev DEV'

options.name: limit
options.description: Usage limit for this policy, e.g. 'limit time-soft SECONDS' or 'limit byte-hard SIZE' (repeatable)

options.name: tmpl
options.description: Add a transform template describing the SA to apply, e.g. 'tmpl src ADDR dst ADDR proto esp mode tunnel' (repeatable)

get

options.name: dev

options.name: index
options.description: Explicit policy index, used instead of a selector

options.name: dir
options.description: Traffic direction of the policy

options.name: ctx
options.description: SELinux security context of the policy

options.description: Mark that must match for this policy

options.name: mask
options.description: Mask applied to the preceding mark value

options.name: ptype
options.description: Policy type

options.name: if_id
options.description: Interface ID binding this policy to an xfrm interface
